name: Raja Rajeswari Seetha Raman

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Raja Rajeswari Seetha Raman is a Malaysian poet, translator and literary critic whose work connects Malay literature with readers across languages. Her collections include Mekar Bunga. In her account of the 2025 Toshali Literature Festival in Odisha, she describes the launch of Metamorfosis, her Malay translation of poems by Pradeep Biswal, alongside an Odia translation of her own poetry by Pragyan Prabartika Dash.

“Embrace Solitude in Grace” treats time alone as a source of imagination and renewed purpose. Its repeated invitations build into a catalogue of what solitude may hold: books, colour, love, ideas and words. The poem’s encouraging voice presents inward attention as a way to return to life with greater openness.
